Hi Amit — great to hear from you. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Marissa (channel) to own approvals and partner listing questions.

Quick answers:
- Listing: Redwood has an existing AWS Marketplace listing for our Standard SaaS plan, but the CPPO needs to reference product/plan SKUs. If the SOW maps to our Standard SaaS SKU, no new listing is required; we just create the CPPO tied to that SKU. Marissa will confirm SKU mapping.
- Pricing worksheet: attaching our CPPO worksheet (cppo_template.xlsx) — fill in the list price and the reseller discount.
- Timeline: typical AWS CPPO review + processing is 3–7 business days once the CPPO is submitted, assuming no seller account mismatches. If we need to create a new private listing, add ~5 business days.

Next steps I propose:
1) Amit: send ResellCo AWS Seller ID + confirm which Redwood SKU to use.
2) ResellCo: populate cppo_template.xlsx with proposed list price and discount; include the contract term and billing cadence.
3) Ben/Marissa: internal approvals for discount tiers and signoff.
4) We schedule a 30-min CPPO handoff call this week to finalize.

Can you share the seller ID and a couple times tomorrow or Thursday?

Jordan Blake

Thanks for looping me in. A couple of clarifications from pricing/commercial:
- Recommended net pricing band for CPPOs for this segment: 15%–25% net on ARR for first-year committed deals > $150k. For ACME at $180k ARR, a 20% net gives good margin and room for reseller margin.
- Approval flow: discounts > 20% need director approval (that's me). Anything >30% requires VP sign-off.
- Deal ID: I've created RDW-ACME-2026-11 in HubSpot; please add the CPPO draft there so we have a single source of truth. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Marissa — can you confirm SKU mapping and whether we need a new private listing or can reuse existing SKU? Also can you prepare the CPPO request packet we send to AWS (cover letter + signed reseller attestation)?

Amit — once you drop the seller ID I'll validate it against AWS console.

-Ben
